text:
morgan: Quick heads-up: we want SDKs to start sending a capacity hint header so router can prefer reserved pools when available. Header: `x-rd-capacity: mode=reserved;level=high` (semicolon or comma accepted). This is header-only, but some clients/proxies sign or whitelist headers.
ellen: Can we backfill from SDKs? Risk: changing inferred defaults for older clients.
raj: Proposal: opt-in env var RD_CAPACITY_HINT for one week canary, then auto-enable but router only honors if project toggle is on in console. That avoids surprises.
kai: Telemetry needs: event `route.capacity_hint` with low-card keys: mode, level, tenant_id. Sam-style sampling for example payloads.
morgan: SDK plan: Python/TS/Go add constructor option + env var; include small shim to lowercase header name. Also document signature caveat and advise body metadata for strict-sign customers.
deploy-bot: feature-flag created eng-platform:capacity-hint-canary at 2026-02-14T17:22Z
ellen: Console owners: add a "Capacity hint" split in per-route dashboard and cost delta table. raj: I'll write the RFC + migration doc. kai: I'll PR telemetry schema today. Any objections?
morgan: None. We'll sync tomorrow 9am PT if needed.
